prOriginal.nota: Found via the commit history of addGuests.handler.ts (first commit baa9045af7, 'feat: ability to add guests via app.cal.com/bookings (#14740)'). PR headRefOid equals the benchmark head and the merged handler is byte-identical to the benchmark head. The repo calcom/cal.com now redirects to calcom/cal.diy.

add-guest-management-functionality-to-ex.reason: PR #17017 changed `isTeamAdmin(...) && isTeamOwner(...)` to `||` in addGuests.handler.ts, so team ADMINs pass the check. The check was later replaced by PermissionCheckService (#24026, fallback OWNER/ADMIN) and is absent today, but the fix came first.

PR #24298 rewrote the filter to compare `extractBaseEmail(guest).toLowerCase()` against the lowercased blacklist; today sanitizeAndFilterGuests still does `blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(baseGuestEmail)` with the lowercased input, so mixed case no longer bypasses it.
PR #24298 added a Set-based dedup of input guests by lowercased base email (now deduplicateGuestEmails), so repeated emails in one request are collapsed before createMany.

Today the handler still reads booking.attendees, filters in memory, then BookingRepository.updateBookingAttendees runs a separate booking.update with attendees.createMany, no transaction or lock. schema.prisma Attendee still has only indexes on email/bookingId, no unique (bookingId,email), so concurrent requests can both insert.

PR #24298 made the existing-attendee dedup case-insensitive, but validateUserPermissions today still uses `attendee.email === user.email`, so an attendee whose stored email differs in case is still FORBIDDEN. Half of the TP's behaviour remains.

astra.pergunta: Dedup half fixed by #24298, authorization still case-sensitive today; which status for the TP as a whole?
astra.resposta: pendente: partial fix, the authorization still compares case-sensitively and can return FORBIDDEN for a valid attendee, so the defective behaviour still exists.

add-guest-management-functionality-to-ex.reason: PR #24298 changed `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` to pass uniqueGuests; today sendGuestNotifications passes uniqueGuestEmails (filtered of existing attendees) as newGuests, so a re-submitted existing attendee no longer gets AttendeeScheduledEmail.

PR #24414 moved the calendar update into updateCalendarEvent, building EventManager from `...booking.user` with getUsersCredentialsIncludeServiceAccountKey(booking.user) instead of ctx.user, so the organizer's credentials are used. Still so today.

The flow is unchanged today: guests are persisted via updateBookingAttendees, then `await updateCalendarEvent(booking, evt)` runs with no try/catch in the handler, and EventManager.updateCalendarAttendees still just awaits updateAllCalendarEvents (which keeps its internal try/catch). No upstream change touched this ordering or error handling.

validateUserPermissions today still authorizes `isOrganizer || isAttendee`, so any attendee can add guests and trigger invites; the permission model is unchanged (team-admin path was dropped, attendee path kept).

addGuests.schema.ts today is `guests: z.array(ZGuestSchema)` with no .max(); the tRPC route uses authedProcedure with no extra limit, and the handler inserts all filtered guests and emails each attendee. No size cap was added.

AddGuestsDialog.tsx today: onSuccess still only toasts, closes and resets multiEmailValue, and handleAdd's success branch never calls setIsInvalidEmail(false); only the Cancel button clears it. The stale error banner can still reappear.

PR #24414 replaced the sendAddGuestsEmails call with BookingEmailSmsHandler.handleAddGuests, which passes eventType metadata to the new sendAddGuestsEmailsAndSMS; it checks eventTypeDisableHostEmail and shouldSkipAttendeeEmailWithSettings before sending.
PR #22247 (fix: Duplicate calendar event when a guest is added) added `iCalUID: booking.iCalUID` to the CalendarEvent built in addGuests.handler.ts; buildCalendarEvent still sets it today.

The handler still throws FORBIDDEN with message 'you_do_not_have_permission' and AddGuestsDialog still renders t(err.message), but the key is absent from packages/i18n/locales/en/common.json today, so the raw key is still shown.
